request.content: Hi Helix, I am Mira. I keep my reports local and want different files to have distinct names. Suggest a simple naming approach and explain why.

foreground.thought: A simple naming convention you can use is to combine the project name or category with a timestamp in YYYYMMDD format (e.g., `Report_ProjectName_YYYYMMDD.ext`). This approach ensures each file has a distinct identifier, makes sorting chronological easy, and clearly indicates the purpose of the report. For example: `MeetingNotes_QA20231015.pdf`. The rationale is that timestamps uniquely order files over time while the project/category prefix groups related content together without needing complex hierarchical folders.
